description: 80-dps evaluation of Seniority-0 Temperley-Lieb Kramers pairing on time-reversed spin-orbit subshells, the Borromean 3-alpha Hoyle threshold inequality (8Be unbound vs 12C bound) and 16O/12C (4-alpha/3-alpha) excess binding ratio under both H_3 and H_4 GPMT modified-dimension cumulants, and the Rayleigh-Bohr-Wheeler spheroidal quadrupole Coulomb-surface balance on open-shell actinides (238U). Companion to Lean 4 QOU.Nuclear.SeniorityPairingAndHoyleTriadThreshold. Zero fitted parameters, zero float64 intermediates.
caveats: In Part 2, the dimensionless H_3(q) GPMT cumulant ratio w_4/w_3 = -2 predicts the scale-free 4-alpha/3-alpha excess binding ratio DeltaB(16O)/DeltaB(12C) = 4 - 2 = 2.0000 (+0.7816% vs experimental 1.984490), whereas unscaled nucleon-level 1*w3_GPMT = 0.683919 MeV and 3*w3_GPMT = 2.051757 MeV underpredict the absolute inter-alpha triangle scale w_{3alpha}^{(exp)} = 7.550268 MeV by a coarse-graining factor of 11.03971 (an open H_{12}(q) multi-cluster renormalization problem). In Part 3, both the linear prolate slope q_lin and the quadratic diabatic curvature q_curv in active shells N=5 and N=6 are weighted by the occupied BCS pair probabilities v2_p (11 pairs) and v2_n (17 pairs) with zero phantom stiffness from empty orbitals, yielding exact spherical stability beta_2^*(208Pb) = 0 on doubly-magic 208Pb, occupied-BCS self-consistent prolate equilibrium beta_2^*(238U) = 0.221069 (DeltaB_def^* = +28.605874 MeV on A=238 vol) / beta_2^*(238U) = 0.339533 (DeltaB_def^* = +55.069639 MeV on k=3 poly), and direct variational exponential-BCS equilibrium beta_2^*(238U) = 0.237251 (DeltaB_def^* = +3.076901 MeV on A=238 vol) / beta_2^*(238U) = 0.362634 (DeltaB_def^* = +13.868080 MeV on k=3 poly).
q0AnchorReason: Evaluates Seniority-0 Temperley-Lieb Kramers pairing gaps, Borromean 3-alpha Hoyle threshold and 4-alpha/3-alpha GPMT cumulant ratios (H_3 vs H_4), and 238U spheroidal quadrupole Coulomb-surface balance across both the physical proton pin and ideal muon pin.
